    About the Founder

    LEADERSHIP 100% FREE MANIFESTO
    1. The Genesis: How the Journey Started

    In late 2024, amidst the continuous hum of digital notifications and algorithmic feeds, I noticed something alarming in myself and everyone around me: smartphones had ceased to be productivity tools and had quietly become dopamine casinos. Behavioral loops carefully tuned by tech giants were bleeding 4 to 8 hours a day from our lives, fracturing our capacity for deep, quiet concentration, and replacing real-world mastery with empty digital highs.

    When I committed to undertaking the Winter Arc—a 90-day seasonal crucible of radical discipline, rigorous workouts, cold focus, and silent self-reinvention—I searched for a software system to anchor my daily execution. What I found was unacceptable:

    Predatory Subscriptions: $10–$15 monthly paywalls just to check a basic daily habit box.
    Invasive Surveillance: Mandatory cloud accounts harvesting personal routines and screen time vulnerabilities.
    Fragile Online Apps: Cluttered interfaces that broke without internet and rewarded superficial vanity streaks.

    At 2:00 AM on a freezing night, frustrated with bloated apps that took more attention than they saved, I opened a clean code editor and began engineering Arc Tracker. The thesis was uncompromising: an ironclad, local-first discipline operating system built to protect your attention as fiercely as armor protects a soldier—completely offline, zero data tracking, and brutally honest about where your time goes.

    "When you master your attention, you master your destiny. A person who commands their daily rituals in silence cannot be conquered by algorithms."
    2. Goals & Core Vision

    Reclaim 10,000,000 Hours

    Our singular metric of success is not daily active app impressions—it is how many millions of wasted hours users steal back from doomscrolling feeds to invest into their physical health, craft, businesses, and families.

    Tangible Impact

    Absolute Data Sovereignty

    Your discipline vulnerabilities, screen time logs, and personal reflections belong exclusively to you. Arc Tracker is engineered with an airgapped privacy model: zero telemetry, zero analytics tracking, and instant raw JSON data control.

    Zero Surveillance

    Elevating Human Willpower

    Motivation is an emotion that fades; systems are cold structures that endure. Our vision is to combine neuroscience-backed habit architecture with tactile RPG progression to make daily discipline visceral, engaging, and permanent.

    Habit Architecture
    3. The Free Manifesto: Why Arc Tracker Is 100% Free Forever
    Self-Discipline Is a Human Right, Not a Luxury Subscription

    When someone is struggling with phone addiction, feeling stagnant, or attempting to rebuild their self-respect from the ashes, the absolute last thing they need is a $12.99/month paywall blocking their ability to track their habits. Self-mastery tools should be universal weapons available to anyone with the heart to put in the work.

    Zero Cloud Overhead by Architectural Design

    Arc Tracker was deliberately designed as a 100% offline-first, client-side application. Your device's browser, IndexedDB storage engine, and local Web Workers do all the computing. Because we do not run multimillion-dollar centralized surveillance server farms tracking your daily check-ins, our server overhead is virtually zero—which means we never have a reason to bill you.

    Zero Venture Capital • Zero Advertising • Zero Compromises

    There is no board of venture capital investors demanding monthly growth targets or user attention monetization. There are no advertising SDKs selling your habits to third-party ad brokers. Arc Tracker is an independent labor of conviction created to serve your focus and sharpen your mind.

    What is Arc Gold VIP? (Voluntary Patronage, Never Feature-Gating)

    To support ongoing development and engineering, Arc Gold exists solely as an optional VIP patronage tier for supporters who appreciate aesthetic luxuries—such as exclusive 4K 16:9 laptop wallpapers and generative ambient audio drones. Every core productivity feature, habit tracker, rule engine, screen time matrix, and dopamine blocker is—and will always remain—100% free for everyone.

    Mayank • Founder & Architect

    "Transform in silence. Let your daily habits and undeniable results speak for you."

    2. Focus Shield & Application Lockout Authorization By initiating a Focus Session or enabling Strict Focus Mode, you authorize Arc Tracker to monitor foreground app titles and active browser domains to enforce distraction lockout shields.

    Arc Tracker Terms & Conditions (Protocol v2026.2)

    Covenant of Self-Discipline & Privacy

    By registering or using Arc Tracker, you agree to these Terms and Conditions. Arc Tracker is an airgapped, high-accountability operating system designed for self-mastery, screen time moderation, and habit execution.

    01. First-Time Registration & Operative Identity

    You choose a display name, handle (@operative), and lock-in motto. Participation in the Winter Arc and Summer Arc protocols is voluntary and intended solely for personal self-improvement.

    02. Local Data Sovereignty & Zero Exfiltration

    100% of habit data, check-ins, journal notes, and screen time records reside on your personal device storage (LocalStorage and IndexedDB). No data is covertly sold, tracked, or monetized.

    03. Focus Mode & Application Lockout Authorization

    Enabling Focus Sessions or Strict Mode authorizes Arc Tracker to detect foreground distraction apps and active browser tabs, actively blocking or shielding distractions according to your blocklist rules.

    04. Arc Gold VIP & Customization

    Gold VIP unlocks 4K wallpapers, custom avatar lining rings, Black & White Monochrome mode, and advanced telemetry exports without deceptive auto-renewals.

    05. Security PIN, Two-Factor Authentication & Backups

    You are the sole custodian of your PIN and 2FA recovery codes. Backups use client-side AES-256 encryption. Lost passcodes cannot be retrieved by third parties.

    06. Fair Execution & Integrity

    Streaks, levels, and milestone badges represent truthful execution. Progress export renders local canvas images for personal sharing.

    Launch When Device Turns On

    Start Arc Tracker as soon as your computer or phone turns on. Keep your dopamine shield and habits active 24/7 without having to remember to open the app.

    Windows 10 / 11 (Automatic 1-Click) RECOMMENDED

    Download the 1-Click Windows Startup installer script. It automatically registers Arc Tracker into your personal Windows Startup folder (shell:startup).

    Android Phone & Tablet
    1. Open device Settings ➔ Apps ➔ Arc Tracker.
    2. Tap Battery ➔ Unrestricted / Allow background activity.
    3. Enable Auto-start / Launch on reboot (on Xiaomi, OnePlus, Samsung & Realme devices).
    4. In Recent Apps overview, tap the Lock 🔒 icon on Arc Tracker to keep it pinned in memory.
    Apple macOS

    Open System Settings ➔ General ➔ Login Items, click the + button under "Open at Login", and select Arc Tracker.

    Auto-Start Setting Preference Record auto-start status in your operative profile
